name: site/social-icon
title: SocialIcon
summary: A round icon link to a social profile: the platform is detected from the URL's host and drawn with its glyph and named for assistive technology, with a generic globe for an unknown host.

props.name: url
props.description: The profile's full URL, protocol included; it is the link's href.

props.name: size
props.description: The glyph's width and height in px.

props.name: label
props.description: Overrides the detected name (the platform, else the host) used for aria-label and title.

behaviour: Renders one <a> to `url` that opens a new tab with rel="me noopener noreferrer" (rel=me verifies the profile, e.g. on Mastodon).

The host (lower-cased, without www.) picks the platform: LinkedIn (linkedin.com, lnkd.in), X (x.com, twitter.com, t.co), Instagram, GitHub, YouTube (youtube.com, youtu.be), Threads, Bluesky (bsky.app), Facebook (facebook.com, fb.me), TikTok, ORCID, and Mastodon for any mastodon.* or *.social host. Anything else is `generic` (a globe).
The link carries data-social-platform="<key>" and its name (aria-label and title): `label`, else the platform's name, else the host.
The glyph is one aria-hidden <svg> of `size` px.

mastodon.description: A Mastodon server, matched by pattern, at a larger size.

generic.description: An unknown host: the globe, named by the host.

labelled.description: A label overrides the detected name.

keyboard: Tab reaches the link; Enter follows it (in a new tab).
focus: Relies on the browser's default focus outline.
aria: The link is named by aria-label (also the title tooltip); the glyph is aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: Nothing: the glyph is muted text, foreground on hover, on a muted hover wash. Platform glyphs are drawn in currentColor, never in the platform's brand colour.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: A fixed 36px circle at every width.
contract:
contract
  slot is "social-icon"
  label is "LinkedIn"
  class contains "rounded-full"
  when mastodon label is "Mastodon"
  when generic label is "example.org"
  when labelled label is "Someone on GitHub"
  a "LinkedIn" min_height 36
end

checks.say: A link to the profile that opens a new tab safely and verifies the profile.
A Mastodon server is matched by pattern.
An unknown host falls back to the globe.
A label overrides the name; the platform is still detected.

gaps: The link is 36px (`w-9 h-9`) on every pointer: it meets WCAG 2.5.8 (24px) but not the 44px coarse-pointer target the app family uses.
No explicit focus style: it relies on the browser outline rather than `--ring`.
A URL that does not parse still renders as the link's href, named by an empty host (the `'External link'` fallback is unreachable because the host is `''`, not null).
